At 3Shape, we are transforming digital dentistry through innovative software, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices. As part of our Platform Engineering department, the Developer Experience team is responsible for improving how software is built, tested, deployed, and maintained across Product Creation, our R&D organization.

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer who is passionate about developer productivity, engineering excellence, and making it easier for software teams to deliver high-quality solutions. Ultimately, you will help shape and operate the tooling and platforms used by engineers across Product Creation.

The role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer in the Developer Experience team, you will play a key role in modernizing and standardizing software delivery practices across Product Creation. You will work closely with development teams, architects, engineering leaders, and security specialists to create a seamless development experience built around automation, self-service capabilities, and modern engineering standards. Your role will be within developer experience, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, engineering enablement and security.

What you'll do

• 
Develop, maintain, and improve shared GitHub Actions workflows and reusable CI/CD components used across the organization.

• 
Help teams migrate from TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, and Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions, making software delivery more modern, consistent, and maintainable.

• 
Improve the reliability, observability, and security of CI/CD workflows, including better monitoring, troubleshooting, and guardrails.

• 
Define and support GitHub repository standards, templates, permissions, and best practices so teams have a well-governed foundation for source control and delivery.

• 
Support the adoption and practical use of GitHub Copilot, including enablement, governance, and guidance for engineering teams.

• 
Enable better use of the tools and services owned by the Developer Experience team by resolving issues, improving workflows, and sharing good practices.

• 
Maintain and improve selected services running on vSphere virtualization platforms.

• 
Work with the team to integrate security tools and practices into the software development lifecycle.

What we're looking for

• 
You are an experienced DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or CI/CD specialist who enjoys improving developer productivity and helping engineering teams succeed.

• 
You bring at least 5 years of experience in DevOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, developer tooling, or similar areas. You have strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms, including building reliable, reusable automation and improving observability and security.

• 
You are comfortable with GitHub repositories, source control practices, branching strategies, permissions, templates, and repository governance. You have strong troubleshooting skills, communicate clearly, and enjoy working with many different development teams.

• 
You have experience with Microsoft Azure or cloud-native development practices, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and platform engineering concepts. Experience with VMware vSphere or similar virtualization platforms is also relevant.

• 
You are proactive, take ownership, and are comfortable working in an agile environment with many stakeholders. Professional proficiency in English is expected.

• 
You have experience with GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools, or a strong interest in applying them to improve engineering workflows.

Additional experience that would be valuable

Experience with security solutions and practices that protect against software supply chain attacks would be highly relevant. This could include Software Composition Analysis, dependency governance, vulnerability scanning, secret scanning, SAST, DAST, code scanning, or similar security and quality tooling.

Why join us?

Developer Experience plays a central role in how software is delivered at 3Shape. By improving our tooling, CI/CD platforms, developer workflows, and AI-assisted development capabilities, the team helps Product Creation deliver value faster and with higher quality.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the daily experience of software engineers across 3Shape. You will help simplify software delivery, improve developer productivity, and contribute to the future of engineering practices in Product Creation.

What 3Shape offers

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 20 nationalities in our DK-based office from all different backgrounds

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Good work/life balance.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Our purpose: We empower dental professionals to provide superior care for every patient, every time

Please contact Kjeld Lau Petersen (Kjeld.Petersen@3shape.com) for more information.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
About the Platform

Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

About the Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

What You Will Do

Event Processing & Pipelines

• 
Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query

• 
Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics

• 
Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems

• 
Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

Detection & Enrichment Services

• 
Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring

• 
Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty

• 
Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release

• 
Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

APIs & Integration

• 
Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services

• 
Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)

• 
Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers

• 
Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

Running What We Build

• 
Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer

• 
Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down

• 
Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

• 
Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development

• 
Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it

• 
Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes

• 
Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment

• 
Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)

• 
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment

• 
Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution

• 
Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge

• 
Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)

• 
Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

Platform and engineering breadth

• 
Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)

• 
Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)

• 
Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)

• 
Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)

• 
Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)

• 
Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)

• 
Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

• 
Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns

• 
Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

Domain

• 
Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)

• 
Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic

• 
Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments

• 
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

Machine learning and data science

• 
Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning

• 
MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)

• 
Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies

• 
Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data

• 
Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

Why Join Us

You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

jobs.description:
Are you a tech-minded graduate ready to make an impact within technology and transformation? Do you want to explore different career paths within consulting – and find the right match for you?

On 18-19 November 2026, we invite ambitious soon-to-be or recent Graduates to Deloitte’s Talent Discovery Days - your opportunity to get to know the different career paths and work with cases in Deloitte Technology & Transformation leading to a potential position in one of our offerings.

Technology & Transformation

In Deloitte Denmark, our Technology & Transformation teams work with the intersection of business and technology to help organizations navigate change and turn technology into practical, impactful solutions.

You will join a collaborative environment with ambitious colleagues, where learning, development, and teamwork are key – and where you get the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally.

What can you expect?

During the Talent Discovery Days, not two moments will be alike. You will collaborate with peers on case challenges, meet our consultants, and explore the different opportunities within Technology & Transformation. Among other things you will:

• Work on case exercises and tackle real-life client challenges with peers

• Meet our consultants and hear their career stories first-hand

• Explore our tech teams and discover where your skills and interests fit in

• Get the chance to move forward: based on the days, selected participants will be invited to individual interviews with the possibility of a job offer in the following period

Please note: Discovery Day takes place over two full days, and participants are expected to be able to attend both days. In addition, selected participants must be available for potential follow-up calls after both day 1 and day 2 as part of the assessment process.

Who are we looking for?

At Deloitte, we look for curiosity, drive, and passion for combining business and technology to create impact. A candidate who is:

A soon-to-be or recent graduate (up to 2 years of experience) within Computer Science, Engineering, IT or Business IT

• In possession of a valid Danish work and residence permit

• An interest in the balance and intersection between technology and business

• A problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges

• A passionate learner eager to grow your skills and career

• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments

• A candidate with a passion for collaborating with customers to solve their problems

Here you can read more about our offerings and what type of candidates they specifically are looking for:

AI & Data

In AI & Data, we help organizations solve their complex challenges by turning data into a strategic asset. This means you'll be hands-on with projects that span the entire data journey – from shaping AI strategy and building modern data platforms to developing and implementing agentic and generative AI, machine learning, analytics and automation solutions. You will collaborate with a team of advisors and deep-tech specialists to deliver tangible results for clients across all industries. We practice what we preach, applying AI-powered tools in our own work to enhance quality and accelerate delivery.

We are looking for curious and ambitious problem-solvers with a genuine interest in the connection between data, technology, and business. You don't need to be an expert yet, but an understanding of data engineering, data science, or AI concepts is essential, along with a strong desire to learn and grow.

ServiceNow

We combine consulting with hands-on implementation of ServiceNow solutions to help organizations streamline and future-proof their operations. Our work spans process automation, performance tracking, and digital workflow optimization across functions such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk and Compliance.

We are looking for curious and motivated candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You may lean more towards technical development or towards project and process work, but you should be interested in understanding how digital solutions support business outcomes.

You are not expected to have ServiceNow expertise before joining - competencies will be developed through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think abstractly and translate ideas into tangible solutions. For example, you should be able to interpret a written process description and visualize or structure it into a clear process flow.

Customer

At Deloitte Digital, we help organizations transform their front-office by designing and implementing CRM solutions across sales, marketing, and service. We are looking for talented colleagues who understand how technology supports customer-facing processes and are eager to work hands-on with CRM platforms.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of business and technology, can translate client requirements into practical solutions and is motivated to develop both functional expertise and technical skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

Finance Transformation

In Finance Transformation, we help organizations modernize and improve the entire CFO area, from invoicing and reporting to finance strategy and financial planning. By combining business insight, technology, data, and process excellence, we help finance functions become more efficient and better equipped to support strategic decision-making.

As a junior consultant, you will gain exposure to a variety of projects across the CFO agenda and work closely with both colleagues and clients. This gives you the opportunity to build a broad understanding of finance transformation before gradually developing deeper expertise within a specific area that matches your interests and strengths.

We are looking for curious and analytical candidates with an interest in the intersection of business, finance, and technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, and collaborating with stakeholders to create practical solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Supply Chain & Network Operations

In Supply Chain & Network Operations (SCNO), we help organizations transform how they plan, optimize, and execute their supply chains. You'll work hands-on configuring platforms like Kinaxis Maestro and SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), implementing decision intelligence solutions, and enabling resilient supply chains. You will collaborate with supply chain strategists, technical and industry experts to deliver transformational outcomes across complex, global supply networks.

You will translate supply chain requirements into technical solutions, work directly with client teams on implementation, and develop expertise in planning, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, and product lifecycle management. You'll gain exposure to digital thread designs connecting product design, manufacturing, and supply chain execution. You'll grow both technical skills in platform implementation and consulting skills in translating client challenges into designs.

We seek curious and ambitious candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You should be a collaborative team player who genuinely cares about client impact and learning from colleagues. You don't need platform expertise - competencies develop through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think systematically about interconnected processes, translate business requirements into technical specifications, and collaborate across teams.

Whats next?

Expected start: January 2027 & September 2027

Location: Deloitte, Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S

We only have a limited number of seats available, so do not hesitate to send your application before 8th November.

To apply, please upload your CV, you transcript of grades, and answer our three short questions. Please note that Talent Discovery Day is an invitation-only event. Once you have submitted your application and all required documents, we will review your profile.

You may attend the event only if you are selected and receive an official invitation email from Deloitte; submitting an application does not itself grant access to the event.

We will look at applications on an ongoing basis and you will receive answer no later than  11 November.

If you have any questions, please contact Sarah Manniche (Manager, People & Purpose).

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
